property_summary: A call to SetMinSum that reverts must leave MinSum unchanged (only successful calls update it); the mutant updates MinSum even when it reverts afterward, so after initialization a reverted SetMinSum(v) leaves MinSum()==v in M but unchanged in P.

Any failed (reverting) call to SetMinSum must leave MinSum unchanged, while any successful call must set MinSum to exactly the requested value; the mutant writes MinSum before reverting, so a reverted SetMinSum leaves MinSum changed.

For any requested value v, a call to SetMinSum either succeeds and sets MinSum to exactly v, or reverts and leaves MinSum unchanged; the mutant writes MinSum before the initialized-check revert, so after initialization a reverted SetMinSum(v) leaves MinSum()==v instead of unchanged.

A SetMinSum call may change MinSum only when it succeeds: once the vault is initialized every further SetMinSum(v) reverts and must leave MinSum exactly at its previously committed value, whereas the mutant writes v before the initialized-check, so a reverted call changes MinSum.

Once the vault is initialized, no SetMinSum call can succeed, so MinSum must remain permanently equal to the value committed before initialization; the mutant writes _val before the initialized-check revert, so a reverted SetMinSum(v) leaves MinSum()==v instead of the pre-initialization value.
For any address a and any caller, calling c.SetLogFile(a) (before initialization) must set the public Log reference so that c.Log() == a; the mutant never assigns it, leaving c.Log() == address(0).
